newsitem.title: INDIA: India, U.K. sign oil cooperation MOU.
newsitem.headline: India, U.K. sign oil cooperation MOU.

text.p: The United Kingdom has agreed to provide information on its oil industry to India, a news release said.
Under a memorandum of understanding signed at an energy conference here, the U.K. oil and gas directorate will provide assistance to its Indian counterpart.

The U.K. will provide India with details of its oil exploration and licensing procedures, policies and regulations in offshore areas, and details on field development, production and decommissioning of old facilities.
It will also provide information and training in information technology and send experts to India to train its directorate's staff.
Indian staff would also visit facilities in the U.K.
The news release said most of the funding for the project will be provided by the U.K.
